title: Päijät-Häme: 0.5 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €41,000 a year
markdown:
# Päijät-Häme: 0.5 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €41,000 a year

> 0.5 more patients a year treated to cure · €41,000 of €1M · €959,000 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Päijät-Häme, 30 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. The difference is within what chance alone gives a county of this size. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, about 1.0 patient a year is missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 0.0–5.6). [^care_curative] [^model] Compared with Finland as a whole, none are missing (range 0.0–1.2 a year), so there is no shortfall to split between surgery and radiotherapy. [^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 29.6% to 30.0% by 2028: 0.5 more patients a year (range 0.0–0.5), for €41,000 a year, about €82,000 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 1 | **Thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate**[^ev_surgeon_second_opinion_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; chief of thoracic surgery at the university hospital | €41,000 | 0.5 (0.0–0.5) | Agree with the university hospital that a thoracic surgeon joins the weekly lung meeting, and send last quarter's stage I-II patients who were not operated for a second look. | Share of patients operated: 11.8% → 12.2% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€41,000** | **0.5 (0.0–0.5)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €633,566 a year; modelled to avoid 1.1 deaths a year (0.2–2.8). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 29.6% (2019–2023, measured) → 30.0% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients operated: 11.8% → 12.2% by 2028. [^care_surgery][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The unspent €959,000 buys nothing more toward treatment that aims to cure. [^model] The access measures are limited by the reachable part of the measured shortfall, not by money. [^model] Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers needs a national decision. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 104 deaths a year in Päijät-Häme, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.1 of them. [^deaths] [^model]

## Limits

- Effects are ranges, not probabilities. Each shows the lowest and highest result when every assumed effect moves together from its lower to its upper bound. [^model]
- The expected share is adjusted only for the share of residents aged 65 or over, not stage, illness, histology, how cancer was found, smoking or recording. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is not used here. None of 3 measured outcomes moved with it as expected beyond chance. [^model]

removed.sentence: More would come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision.
removed.reason: The source lists screening only as needing a national decision. It does not say screening would add more, and the sentence had no source marker. The clause 'More would come from' was cut and the supported part kept with [^model].

removed.sentence: Ranking measures by deaths avoided instead would also add more. [^model]
removed.reason: The source does not say this. It only says the deaths objective shows what else the money could do. Those pathway measures do not change who gets treated to cure, so 'also add more' after the screening sentence misstates the source.

flagged.sentence: The unspent €959,000 buys nothing more toward treatment that aims to cure.
flagged.reason: The sentence carries a number but had no source marker. The supporting id is clearly model (plan.left_eur, saturation_note), so [^model] was added.

flagged.sentence: Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not stage, illness, histology, how cancer was found, smoking or recording.
flagged.reason: The measured shares (30 vs 27) are not adjusted. Only the expected share is, and only for the share of residents aged 65 or over. The sentence was rewritten so the reader does not take the raw comparison as adjusted.
